description_zh: 提供对 Construc 引擎的生命周期的访问。
description_en: The System plugin provides access to the Construct engine.

conditions.description_zh: 从当前已选取的实例中，选择第n个实例。
conditions.description_en: Pick just the nth instance from the currently picked instances of an object.
conditions.display_zh: 选择第 {1} 个 {0} 实例对象

params.desc_en: Choose the object to pick an instance from.

params.desc_zh: 要选择的实例的索引，从 0 开始计数。
params.desc_en: Index of the instance to pick (0-based).

conditions.description_zh: 从当前已选择的对象实例中随机选择一个实例。
conditions.description_en: Pick a single random instance from the currently picked instances of an object.
conditions.display_zh: 随机选择一个 {0} 实例

params.desc_zh: 选择要从中选择随机实例的对象。
params.desc_en: Choose the object to pick a random instance from.

conditions.description_zh: 重置当前已选取的实例，再次选择所有实例。
conditions.description_en: Reset the picked instances to select all of them again.

params.desc_zh: 选择要重置的对象以选择所有实例。
params.desc_en: Choose the object to reset to pick all instances.

conditions.description_zh: 选择满足比较的对象的实例。
conditions.description_en: Pick instances of an object that meet a comparison.

params.desc_zh: 通过比较选择要选择的对象。
params.desc_en: Choose the object to pick by comparing with.

params.desc_zh: 输入引用所选对象的表达式。 将挑选符合比较的实例。
params.desc_en: Enter an expression referencing the chosen object. Instances that meet the comparison will be picked.
Choose how to compare the above expression for each object.

params.desc_zh: 通过表达式筛选出满足条件的实例对象。可以引用要选择的对象。
params.desc_en: Enter a value to compare the expression to for each instance. It can also reference the chosen object.

conditions.description_zh: 通过计算表达式来选择对象的实例。
conditions.description_en: Pick instances of an object by evaluating an expression.

params.desc_zh: 通过评估选择要选择的对象
params.desc_en: Choose the object to pick by evaluating.

params.desc_zh: 通过表达式的结果选择实例对象，如果结果非零，将选择实例。
params.desc_en: Enter an expression referencing the chosen object. If nonzero, the instance will be picked.

conditions.description_zh: 根据表达式计算结果，选中数值最高或最低的实例。
conditions.description_en: Pick based on evaluating the highest or lowest expression.

params.desc_zh: 选择最高或最低值结果的实例。
params.desc_en: Choose whether to pick according to the highest or lowest expression.

params.desc_zh: 引用所选对象的表达式。
params.desc_en: Enter an expression referencing the chosen object.

params.desc_zh: 当结果出现并列结果时，选中所有并列的实例。否则只选中一个。
params.desc_en: Check to pick all tied instances when there is a tie break. When unchecked, only a single instance will be picked even in a tie break.

conditions.description_zh: 选取在场景中的重叠在一起的一类对象实例。
conditions.description_en: Pick the instances of an object type overlapping a point in the layout.

params.desc_zh: 如果重叠点，请选择要拾取的对象。
params.desc_en: Choose the objects to pick if overlapping a point.
The X co-ordinate to test if overlapping.
The Y co-ordinate to test if overlapping.

conditions.description_zh: 选择对象类型最后一个创建的实例对象，用于 '创建对象 (按名称)' 一起使用。
conditions.description_en: Pick the last created instance of an object type. Useful with 'Create object (by name)'.

params.desc_zh: 选择最后创建的对象实例。
params.desc_en: Choose the object to pick the last created instance from.
